title: model-catalog: capability endpoints — filters, compatibility flags, pricing/limits, streaming & structured-output fixes
author: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Expand model catalog capability endpoints with listing filters, explicit compatibility flags, pricing and limits fields; stabilize streaming responses and improve tool/function-calling metadata and structured-output hints to ensure OpenAI compatibility layer maps reliably. Motivation: Product teams need richer model discovery (filter by capability, latency tier, quantization, region, openai_compat), clearer signals for compatibility (openai_compat, streaming_compatible, function_calling_supported, structured_output_schema), and explicit pricing/limits so clients can make routing decisions without hitting unexpected errors. In addition, recent customer incidents exposed streaming chunking/backpressure edge cases when proxying OpenAI-compatible streams — this PR includes runtime and API-layer fixes to reduce dropped events and to provide deterministic retryable boundaries. Changes include: API: /v1/models and /v1/models/{id}/capabilities updated to accept filter params (capability, min_latency_ms, region, quantization, openai_compat) and to return capability entries with explicit fields: "compat_flags" (comma separated string), "pricing_unit", "price_per_unit_usd", "rate_limit_per_min", "max_sequence_tokens", "preferred_routing_tier". Streaming: improved chunk framing and backpressure handling for OpenAI-compat streaming proxy; added end-of-stream sentinel for partial structured outputs; ensure chunked JSON boundaries for structured-output mode. Tool/function calling: capability metadata now includes function_calling_supported and recommended parameter_schema_uri. Structured output: add optional structured_output_schema_uri and stable example_payload for models advertising structured-output capability. OpenAI compatibility layer: expanded mapping table to map openai-style model names to internal model variants and to expose per-variant price/limit overrides; added a compatibility-mode header to opt into strict OpenAI semantics. Testing & docs: end-to-end integration tests covering listing filters, streaming in compatibility mode, tool-calling metadata resolution, and docs updates under redwood-docs/model-catalog. Migration notes: new fields are additive; clients should fallback gracefully when fields are absent; recommend users pin model versions if relying on price/limit invariants. Rollout: feature flagged; gradual rollout behind feature flag model-catalog-enrichments; default off for Dedicated customers until validated.
